rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a vehicle’s front windscreen.

example.english: The windscreen is cracked; how much does it cost to replace it?
example.traditional: 塊擋風玻璃裂咗，換一塊要幾錢？
example.jyutping: faai3 dong2 fung1 bo1 lei4 lit6 zo2 wun6 jat1 faai3 jiu3 gei2 cin2

rows.note: Use this for the protective cover fitted over a microphone to reduce wind and breathing noise.

example.english: Remember to put the windscreen back on when recording.
example.traditional: 錄音嗰陣記得套返個防風罩。
example.jyutping: luk6 jam1 go2 zan6 gei3 dak1 tou3 faan1 go3 fong4 fung1 zaau3
